DIL 402 Expedis Classic
Product catalog summary
Introduction
NETZSCH dilatometers are essential for measuring expansion or shrinkage during thermal treatment, providing insights into the behavior of ceramics, glasses, and building materials. They help understand binder burnout, sintering behavior, and the impact of additives in ceramics production, adhering to standards like DIN EN 821 and ASTM E831.
Methodology
Pushrod dilatometry involves measuring dimensional changes against temperature or time. The coefficient of expansion (α) is calculated by dividing the degree of expansion by the temperature change. The process includes inserting a rod-shaped sample into a holder, contacting it with a pushrod, and measuring thermal expansion during controlled heating or cooling.
Instrument Features
The DIL 402 Expedis Classic is available in single or dual systems, offering a user-friendly environment with maintenance-free operation and easy sample holder exchange. It features a gas-tight design for precise measurements and controlled contact force to handle delicate samples without deformation.
Advanced Technology
The NanoEye displacement system ensures perfect linearity and maximum resolution, using an opto-electronic sensor for accurate position encoding. The Proteus® software includes advanced features like c-DTA® for simultaneous analysis of length changes and caloric effects, and Identify for database comparison of unknown samples.
Applications
Applications include assessing thermal expansion in refractory materials, understanding sintering behavior in porcelain, and determining quality parameters in glass production. The system can detect phase transitions and softening points, crucial for materials like borosilicate glass and porcelain.
Technical Specifications
The DIL 402 Expedis Classic features a pushrod dilatometer design with interchangeable sample holder systems. It supports heating rates from 0.001 to 50 K/min and offers optional fast cooling systems for specific furnace types.
System Specifications
Operates with one or two pushrods for dual or differential mode usage.
Sample holder made of Al2O3 with a maximum sample length of 52 mm and diameter options of 12 mm (standard) or 19 mm (optional), and 8 mm for dual sample holder systems.
Automatic sample length determination available.
Displacement system: NanoEye.
Temperature accuracy of 1 K, precision of 0.1 K, resolution of 0.001 K, and thermal stability of ± 0.02 K.
Temperature calibration via displacement using metal references or optional c-DTA® for endo/exothermal effects.
Measuring range of ± 5000 µm with a resolution of 2 nm and repeatability of 0.002%.
Force range for samples is 0.01 N to 3 N with a resolution of 0.001 mN.
Gas atmosphere can be inert or oxidizing under static or dynamic conditions, with optional 3-way gas control.
Software compatibility includes Windows 10 Pro® and Enterprise®, and Windows 11 Pro® and Enterprise®.Service and Support
NETZSCH offers comprehensive support and expert service globally, both pre- and post-sale.
Training programs are available to maximize instrument potential.
Services include maintenance, repair, software updates, calibration, and spare part assistance.Company Overview
NETZSCH is an international technology company headquartered in Germany, with over 4,600 employees in 36 countries.
The company specializes in Thermal Analysis, Calorimetry, Thermophysical Properties, Rheology, and Fire Testing.
NETZSCH is committed to providing exceptional performance and customer service.

User-Optimized Environment
Major simplification begins with preparation of the measurement by using method-based test routines predefined by the operator. The MultiTouch feature places the sample into the optimum position using a unique, tail-like motion. The initial sample length is then automatically determined at a predefined contact force. Exchanging the furnace is simple and requires no detailed experience. Only a few clicks are needed to start the measurement.
ALL-IN-ONE DESIGN
DIL Expedis Classic is available as a single or dual/differential system. In both versions, the all-inone design... Open the catalog to page 4
BEST SAMPLE CONDITIONS
Defined atmosphere by gas-tight design and superior insulation are prerequisites for precise measurement results. Such measurement conditions are realized by the gastight design and integrated gas flow device. The gases can be directed through the measuring cell and sample compartment. In addition, insulation of the sample compartment reduces influences of temperature fluctuations on the measurement results.
 Open the catalog to page 5
Dilatometry Redefined CONTROLLED CONTACT FORCE
The controlled contact force allows the operator to measure small, delicate, fragile or foamed samples without risk of breakage and any non-reproducible deformation. The contact pressure over the entire measurement time is kept constant independent of the expansion or shrinkage of the sample. Sliding and rolling friction, stick-slip effects, etc. in the measurement system will now also be avoided.
 Open the catalog to page 6
TEMPERATURE MEASUREMENT AT THE RIGHT SPOT
In order to conveniently measure various sample lengths , the thermocouple is adjustable. A guiding rod accommodates the thermocouple to place it in the desired position without bending.
NanoEye OBSERVES YOUR SAMPLE
The new, pioneering NanoEye displacement system features perfect linearity and maximum resolution over the entire measuring range. The heart of the NanoEye is an optoelectronic sensor able to encode a position and convert it into a digital signal.
